'''''Party Poster''''' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The poster had a non-realistic image of a long-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] individual lifting up both [[Limb/Legends|hands]] while looking upward. Written on the poster in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters were the words "Uhl Eharl Khoehng," which meant "The Trickster King" in [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]], a [[Language/Legends|language]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was considered ancient by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War. [[Uhl Eharl Khoehng (play)|''Uhl Eharl Khoehng'']] was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] tragedy written in Olys Corellisi.

==Description==
''Party Poster'' was a poster showing a non-realistic depiction of an individual with long [[Hair/Legends|hair]] looking upward with both [[Limb/Legends|hands]] lifted high above the individual's head. The individual's mouth was open and had a [[Star/Legends|star]]-shaped object in place of an [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. One of the individual's hands had the index finger pointing upward, while the other hand was held open with a star-shaped object shining brightly from it. At the top, the poster had [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters that read: "Uhl Eharl." It also had Aurebesh text at the bottom of the picture, right below the individual, which read "Khoehng."<ref name="SWG" /> "Uhl Eharl Khoehng" meant "The Trickster King" in [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]], a [[Language/Legends|language]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was considered ancient by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWAJ8">{{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}}</ref>

==History==
During the Galactic Civil War, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Party Poster'' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG" /> The text on the poster<ref name="SWG" /> was the same as the title of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] tragedy, [[Uhl Eharl Khoehng (play)|''Uhl Eharl Khoehng'']], which was written in Olys Corellisi and was considered both ancient and famous by the time of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWAJ8" /> At some point after the Battle of Yavin, a ''Party Poster'' was on one of the walls of the [[Unidentified cantina (Tansarii Point Station)|cantina]] located on [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found a ''Party Poster'' during the Galactic Civil War and thought that the poster was an advertisement for some type of celebration. However, the spacer did not know how long the poster had been around or what the text on the poster was supposed to mean. The spacer thought that the text on the poster might have been slang.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
''Party Poster'' was a poster that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], which was developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment<ref name="SWG" /> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
